scripts.api:lint: uv run --directory apps/api ruff check . && uv run --directory apps/api ruff format --check . && uv run --directory apps/api mypy --strict src tests && uv run --directory apps/api lint-imports

scripts.check: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm api:lint && pnpm api:test
